summary: S3 reuses the existing FastAPI 0.115 / SQLAlchemy 2.x / Pydantic v2 / Alembic 1.14 / psycopg 3.2 stack — zero new backend Python packages required. The dashboard aggregation and sales report queries use SQLAlchemy's existing expression API (case(), func.sum(), select(), .in_(), joined-load relationships). Schema layer is read-only: zero new tables, zero new columns, zero new constraints, zero new indexes, zero migrations. Existing S2 composite indexes (ix_stock_ledger_dgt, ix_sales_header_{sales_date,dealer}, ix_sales_line_dgd) service all S3 query plans.

services.name: PostgreSQL 16
services.setup_notes: Inherits from S1 docker-compose. No new instance, no schema changes — S3 is read-only at the persistence layer.

services.name: Docker (testcontainers)
services.setup_notes: Test execution dependency only — used by backend/tests/conftest.py for ephemeral PG. Inherits from S1.

frontend_deps_note: TBD at /ases-ui-design S3. Likely candidates if the UI design adds a chart panel: recharts (small, React-native, MIT) or visx. No charting is mandated by PRD AC-041..AC-045 — a table layout for the dashboard satisfies the ACs. The 2 new pages (/admin/dashboard/, /admin/reports/sales/) and their date-range / multi-select filter UX dependencies will land via the UI track per the S2 precedent.
